sql-service.name: msa.msa010T1.getVrsList.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT A.SC_SNO ,A.SC_LCLF_CD LCLF_CD ,(select SC_CDNM from tb_sc_code_mng where a.sc_lclf_cd = sc_cd) as LCLF_NM ,SC_SCLF_CD SCLF_CD ,(select SC_CDNM from tb_sc_code_mng where a.sc_sclf_cd = sc_cd) as SCLF_NM ,CNTR_CD -- ,QST_CD ,(select DEPT_NAME from ms_dept Y where A.CNTR_CD =Y.dept_cd) CNTR_NM ,PROD_CD ,(select Y.PROD_NM from ms_product Y where Z.PROD_CD=Y.PROD_CD) PROD_NM ,CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP(1) USER_NAME FROM ms_script_mng S,ms_usermaster U WHERE A.SC_SNO=S.SC_SNO AND A.SC_LCLF_CD = S.SC_LCLF_CD AND A.SC_SCLF_CD=S.SC_SCLF_CD AND S.CNTR_CD = A.CNTR_CD AND A.CHG_DATE=A.CHG_DATE AND S.CHG_ID=U.USER_ID) IS NULL THEN (SELECT TOP(1) USER_NAME+'('+U.USER_ID+')' FROM ms_script_mng S,ms_usermaster U WHERE A.SC_SNO=S.SC_SNO AND A.SC_LCLF_CD = S.SC_LCLF_CD AND A.SC_SCLF_CD=S.SC_SCLF_CD AND S.CNTR_CD = A.CNTR_CD AND A.CHG_DATE=A.CHG_DATE AND S.UPDR_CRNO=U.USER_ID) ELSE (SELECT TOP(1) USER_NAME+'('+U.USER_ID+')' FROM ms_script_mng S,ms_usermaster U WHERE A.SC_SNO=S.SC_SNO AND A.SC_LCLF_CD = S.SC_LCLF_CD AND A.SC_SCLF_CD=S.SC_SCLF_CD AND S.CNTR_CD = A.CNTR_CD AND A.CHG_DATE=A.CHG_DATE AND S.CHG_ID=U.USER_ID) END UP_USER_NM ,A.CHG_DATE ALTR_DT --차후 altr_date형식보고 앞에 20붙인거 해결 FROM ( SELECT a.sc_sno, a.sc_lclf_cd, sc_sclf_cd, cntr_cd, MAX(CHG_DATE) CHG_DATE FROM ms_script_mng a WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY A.SC_SNO,A.SC_LCLF_CD,SC_SCLF_CD,CNTR_CD ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_sc_mng Z ON A.SC_SNO = Z.SC_SNO AND A.SC_LCLF_CD = Z.SC_LCLF_CD WHERE Z.USE_YN = 'Y' ?sc_lclf_cd ?sc_sclf_cd ?cntr_cd ?prod_cd ORDER BY LCLF_CD,SCLF_CD,CNTR_CD,PROD_CD,A.SC_SNO

sql-service.name: msa.msa040T1.delVRS.del
sql-service.query:
BEGIN TRANSACTION; DELETE FROM ms_script_mng FROM tb_sc_qst_mng A , ms_script_mng B WHERE A.SC_SNO = B.SC_SNO AND A.SC_LCLF_CD =B.SC_LCLF_CD AND A.SC_SCLF_CD = B.SC_SCLF_CD AND A.QST_CD = B.QST_CD AND A.CNTR_CD = B.CNTR_CD AND A.CHG_DATE BETWEEN ?sdate AND ?edate AND A.R_FLAG = 'N'
DELETE FROM ms_script_sent FROM tb_sc_qst_mng A , ms_script_sent B WHERE A.SC_SNO = B.SC_SNO AND A.SC_LCLF_CD =B.SC_LCLF_CD AND A.SC_SCLF_CD = B.SC_SCLF_CD AND A.QST_CD = B.QST_CD AND A.CNTR_CD = B.CNTR_CD AND A.CHG_DATE BETWEEN ?sdate AND ?edate AND A.R_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE A SET R_FLAG ='N' FROM tb_sc_qst_mng A LEFT OUTER JOIN ms_script_mng B ON A.SC_SNO = B.SC_SNO AND A.SC_LCLF_CD =B.SC_LCLF_CD AND A.SC_SCLF_CD = B.SC_SCLF_CD AND A.QST_CD = B.QST_CD AND A.CNTR_CD = B.CNTR_CD WHERE B.SC_SNO IS NULL AND B.SC_LCLF_CD IS NULL AND B.SC_SCLF_CD IS NULL AND B.QST_CD IS NULL AND B.CNTR_CD IS NULL AND A.CHG_DATE BETWEEN ?sdate AND ?edate AND A.R_FLAG = 'Y'
COMMIT;

sql-service.name: msa.msa040T1.delVRSupdFlag.del
sql-service.query:
BEGIN TRANSACTION; DELETE FROM ms_script_mng FROM tb_sc_qst_mng A , ms_script_mng B WHERE A.SC_SNO = B.SC_SNO AND A.SC_LCLF_CD =B.SC_LCLF_CD AND A.SC_SCLF_CD = B.SC_SCLF_CD AND A.QST_CD = B.QST_CD AND A.CNTR_CD = B.CNTR_CD AND A.CHG_DATE BETWEEN ?sdate AND ?edate
DELETE FROM ms_script_sent FROM tb_sc_qst_mng A , ms_script_sent B WHERE A.SC_SNO = B.SC_SNO AND A.SC_LCLF_CD =B.SC_LCLF_CD AND A.SC_SCLF_CD = B.SC_SCLF_CD AND A.QST_CD = B.QST_CD AND A.CNTR_CD = B.CNTR_CD AND A.CHG_DATE BETWEEN ?sdate AND ?edate
UPDATE A SET R_FLAG = 'N' FROM tb_sc_qst_mng A WHERE A.CHG_DATE BETWEEN ?sdate AND ?edate
COMMIT;

sql-service.name: msa.msa050.getDmboList.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT A.PROD_CD, (SELECT PROD_NM FROM ms_product WHERE PROD_CD = A.PROD_CD)+' ('+A.PROD_CD+')' AS PROD_NM, A.DMBO_CD, A.DMBO_NM+' ('+A.DMBO_CD+')' AS DMBO_NM, CASE WHEN LEN(B.CHG_ID) > 0 THEN CONCAT((ISNULL((SELECT USER_NAME FROM ms_usermaster WHERE USER_ID = B.CHG_ID),'')), '(' ,ISNULL(B.CHG_ID, ''), ')') ELSE '' END AS CHG_ID, ISNULL(B.CHG_DATE, '') AS CHG_DATE FROM ms_dmbo A WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT PROD_CD , DMBO_CD , (SELECT TOP(1) CHG_ID FROM ms_ment_mng WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE PROD_CD = B.PROD_CD AND DMBO_CD = B.DMBO_CD AND CHG_DATE = MAX(B.CHG_DATE)) AS CHG_ID, MAX(CHG_DATE) AS CHG_DATE FROM MS_MENT_MNG B WITH(NOLOCK) GROUP BY PROD_CD, DMBO_CD ) B ON A.PROD_CD = B.PROD_CD AND A.DMBO_CD = B.DMBO_CD WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' ?prod_cd ?dmbo_cd ORDER BY PROD_CD, DMBO_CD

sql-service.name: msa.msa050.getMentList.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT PROD_CD, (SELECT PROD_NM FROM ms_product WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE PROD_CD = M.PROD_CD) AS PROD_NM, DMBO_CD, (SELECT DMBO_NM FROM ms_dmbo WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE PROD_CD = M.PROD_CD AND DMBO_CD = M.DMBO_CD ) AS DMBO_NM, MENT_CD, MENT_SENT, MENT_KEYWORD, USE_YN, CASE WHEN LEN(M.CHG_ID) > 0 THEN CONCAT((ISNULL((SELECT USER_NAME FROM ms_usermaster WHERE USER_ID = M.CHG_ID),'')), '(' ,ISNULL(M.CHG_ID, ''), ')') ELSE '' END AS CHG_ID, CHG_DATE, CASE WHEN LEN(M.REG_ID) > 0 THEN CONCAT((ISNULL((SELECT USER_NAME FROM ms_usermaster WHERE USER_ID = M.REG_ID),'')), '(' ,ISNULL(M.REG_ID, ''), ')') ELSE '' END AS REG_ID, REG_DATE FROM ms_ment_mng M WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE 1=1 ?prod_cd ?dmbo_cd ORDER BY USE_YN DESC, CONVERT(INT, MENT_CD) ASC
